name: Sleeply
tagline: Simulates and visualises what your brain does through a night's sleep from your habits.
problem: People do not understand how habits affect their sleep.
solution: Builds a sleep profile from duration, stress, caffeine and alcohol, then models sleep stages and shows them as timelines and 3D brain activity.
demo_moment: Team-described: add caffeine and see deep sleep shrink.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best First Time Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
A solo first-time hacker's polished build.

lessons: Visualise the cause and effect of a habit.
